name: Dragon Knight
descr: A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a dragon's head.

data.motivesAndTactics: Exploit an opening, get some distance, knock enemies off-balance, strike from above

features.name: High Ground
features.text: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

features.name: Leaping Strike
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra **1d12** damage, and the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Comeback
features.text: When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can **spend a Fear** to reroll the attack with advantage.
